pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Bundled acme.sh DNS API plugins plus the proxmox-acme wrapper script, used to fulfil DNS-01 ACME challenges for Let's Encrypt certificate issuance. Includes 150+ DNS provider plugins (Cloudflare, AWS Route53, Gandi, OVH, Hetzner, etc.).
NOTE: This bundles acme.sh 3.1.1 rather than using the system app-crypt/acme-sh package, because the proxmox-acme wrapper script uses an internal API not present in stock acme.sh releases.
